meta.name: ecommerce-copywriter
meta.description: 电商图片文案创作技能，支持多品类产品的吸引性文案生成，适用于电商平台的商品营销推广

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为电商商品生成吸引人的营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为电商产品快速撰写吸引眼球的文案
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling marketing copy for ecommerce products
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly write eye-catching copy for ecommerce products

howto.what: 为电商商品生成图片文案和优化已有文案。会先询问产品信息，选用品类模板，按“痛点引入→产品介绍→卖点阐述→行动召唤”四段结构创作，并搭配合适emoji，输出Markdown格式文案。
howto.when: 当用户提出电商文案创作需求、文案优化需求，或需要为电商商品生成营销文案时触发。

say.text: 帮我给智能睡眠眼罩写一条电商文案，突出科学遮光。
say.note: 会按智能家居模板生成完整文案。

say.text: 优化这段充电宝文案，突出大容量和多种接口。
say.note: 会分析原文并重写标题和正文。

say.text: 用环保餐具模板，写一篇强调可降解特点的文案。
say.note: 会按环保生活类模板生成文案。

howto.what_en: Generates ecommerce image copy and optimizes existing copy. It first asks for product info, picks a category template, and writes a four-paragraph structure (pain point, product intro, selling points, call to action) with relevant emojis, outputting Markdown.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for ecommerce copy creation, copy optimization, or marketing copy for a product.

say_en.text: Write an ecommerce ad for a smart sleep eye mask, highlighting scientific light blocking.
say_en.note: Generates copy using the smart home template.

say_en.text: Optimize this power bank copy, focusing on large capacity and multiple ports.
say_en.note: Analyzes original and rewrites headline and body.

say_en.text: Use the eco-friendly tableware template to write copy emphasizing biodegradability.
say_en.note: Generates copy using the eco-friendly category template.
